Each portrait is a head-and-shoulders bust, slightly turned to the right, looking at the viewer with a friendly expression unless stated, inside a rounded-square tile with its own soft painted background that matches the character colors and a thin ornate gold border. TRANSPARENT background outside the tiles (PNG), square 1:1 image. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no grid lines. Draw a 3x3 grid of 9 separate portrait tiles, evenly spaced, each centered in its own cell and filling about 85% of the cell, with clear transparent gaps between tiles. Portraits in reading order (left to right, top to bottom): 1. a young swordsman with brown hair in steel plate armor and a red cape. 2. an agile forest ranger girl with a blonde ponytail and a green hood, elf ears. 3. a young wizard boy with silver hair, deep blue robe and a pointed star hat. 4. a gentle priestess with long copper hair, white and gold robes and a jeweled circlet. 5. a wild berserker with spiky red hair, horned helmet and fur collar, fierce grin. 6. a holy paladin in white-gold plate armor with a winged visored helm raised to show his face, blue cape. 7. a calm marksman with short dark hair, navy coat and brown cape, a small scope monocle. 8. a shadow assassin in a dark purple hood and face mask, glowing green eyes. 9. a fiery elementalist with flaming orange hair and a crimson robe with gold trim, small fire and ice sparks.
